'''December 2000 Rochester tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Millennium Games, Rochester, NY on 16 December 2000. It is known from R. Smith's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1550">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-16-rochester-ny-12-16-2000d1550/ rochester-ny-12-16-2000], DeckTech (R. "Voice of Law" Smith, 16 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-16-rochester-ny-12-16-2000d1550/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 16 December 2000
* '''Site:''' Millennium Games, Rochester, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 14
